vision_landmarks.implementation_status: legacy GRU path; retained for compatibility, not the current C++ translation path

actuator_bedshaker_command.implementation_status: UI publishing API exists; PR #10 Uno MQTT/USB consumer is reviewed separately. Delivery/serial echo is not physical action confirmation.

vision_translation.subscriber: RPi5 Scenario UI / sign shortcut hub
vision_translation.duplicate_handling: QoS 1 DUP + packet identifier + unchanged payload: bounded 128-packet process-local cache. A new publication may repeat the same text.

device_control_command.subscriber: device adapter (Uno candidate in PR #10); Scenario UI currently observes livingroom/aircon

payload_schema.source: string (sign_shortcut; manual_test is a PR #10 extension)
payload_schema.action: set_power (stop for curtain in PR #10 only)

device_control_command.implementation_status: Aircon and curtain/stop extensions adopted from PR #10 into review candidate; no physical completion acknowledgement.

qos.0: 연속적으로 갱신되어 일부 유실을 허용할 수 있는 데이터에 사용한다.
qos.1: 낙상 이벤트 및 액추에이터 명령처럼 전달 보장이 필요한 메시지에 사용한다.

duplicate_handling.description: Safety events: trimmed message_id, last 2000 accepted IDs per UI process; no-ID legacy messages accepted without deduplication. Invalid non-string/blank IDs rejected. Reboot clears cache. Translation uses MQTT packet headers, not this incident-ID cache. Absolute device power commands are idempotent; physical completion is not acknowledged.

retain.policy: 현재 정의된 모든 Topic은 retain=false로 사용한다.

priority.description: MQTT 자체 기능이 아니라 RPi5 Event Manager에서 이벤트 처리 순서를 결정하기 위한 필드이다.

architecture_note: Current reviewed path: RPi4 C++ sign classification publishes translation text and sends camera frames over TCP. RPi5 runs the Python hub, Scenario Flutter UI, local STT and optional context services. Existing GRU/landmark code and assets are preserved as legacy or user work, not reset. SW/wifi_sensing uses local HTTP; an offline CSI envelope adapter alone is not a live alarm integration. PR #9 and PR #10 sources are included as undeployed review candidates.
change_policy: Topic 이름, JSON Key, QoS, retain 및 데이터 타입 변경 시 팀 합의 후 version을 올린다.
